column1: # Rows db.x4excl.* (line RG item X4-excl, 2026-11-20): BLASTP -use_sw_tback with a -negative_seqidlist that keeps a subject without a definition line (its only line has a ti), which NCBI's fetch of the redo excludes (seqsrc_seqdb.cpp:306-314) after the early termination test of its match (blast_kappa.c:3525-3540) and which then sets the status of NCBI's one-thread redo back to 0 (blast_kappa.c:3560-3575; the batch's status is its last reached match's, blast_kappa.c:3774-3779). Databases tests/db_search/x4excl/fwd and rev (version 5, make_x4excl.py; on version 4 such a subject is masked and never searched): last.*: tks_W's failed match against sfail, then sx_frag's excluded match, so NCBI ends with status 0 (exit 0, its reports; with neg_exact.txt the OID mask removes sexact, so the batch's first query holds no redone match), at -comp_based_stats 1, 2 and 3, outfmt 0, 6 and 7 and -max_target_seqs 1 (the heap is empty, so the redo does not end early); last.kept.*: neg.txt keeps sexact, whose redone match is kept before the failure: without the reset NCBI would crash in its clean-up (the form LOSAT refuses, PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS 1.53), with it NCBI reports sexact; last.q2.*: tests/fasta/x4/sw_fail_last.faa, qok1's redone match against sok1, then tks_W's failure and the excluded match; first.*: rev, sx_strong's excluded match before the failure, which stays (BLAST engine error: Traceback failed, exit status 3); et.m1.6: -max_target_seqs 1 with neg.txt, sexact's redone match fills tks_W's heap and sx_frag's best e-value is above 5 x 0.002, so the redo ends early at it and the failure stays: NCBI crashes (exit 139 on ws) and LOSAT refuses. Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --ncbi-bin DIR --program blastp --only db.x4excl.
